requirement.description: {reliability_ruth} proposed that the acceptance criteria be linked to real-world performance monitoring to ensure reliable ML features. The more the acceptance criteria are linked to real-world performance, the better the reliability of the ML features will be.
requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} proposed that the acceptance criteria be linked to real-world performance monitoring to ensure reliable ML features.
requirement.reading: The more the acceptance criteria are linked to real-world performance, the better the reliability of the ML features will be.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Linking acceptance criteria to monitoring is a good start, but I need those metrics to drive automated rollback decisions. I cannot sign off on reliability if we are still manually reviewing performance data after deployment.
output.correction: I did not ask for a new monitoring tool, I asked for a tighter feedback loop between live performance and our release gates. You are misreading my request as a budget item when it is actually a process integration issue.
